title: Lairs as places
description: Lairs as multi-part places on the motion kit, with three stages of decay once left empty, and a running region model on the game's creature data: a rolled cast per map, tiers earned by lairs, a danger balancer, wildfires, years of history before the colony lands, saved runs, a sortable ledger of every group, hunters that come and hunt as hard as the prey allows, and three small hunters (fox, hawk and stoat) with their own lairs, tier ladders and a creature sheet.
